description: Standardized tarot spreads defined for the Palmistry & Tarot Intelligence Platform (Spec §49.6, FR-017..FR-022).

spreads.name: Single Card Spread
spreads.description: A single-card draw providing direct spiritual guidance, daily focus, or a clear answer to a focused inquiry.

positions.name: Core Guidance
positions.description: The primary energy, theme, or lesson currently governing your inquiry.

spreads.name: Three Card Spread (Past, Present, Future)
spreads.description: The classic three-card spread tracing chronological momentum from roots through current experience to emerging trajectory.

positions.name: The Past
positions.description: Foundations, root causes, past lessons, and background energies shaping the present.

positions.name: The Present
positions.description: Current reality, active dynamics, immediate challenges, and where your focus is centered.

positions.name: The Future
positions.description: Emerging trajectory, potential outcome, and advice for navigating what lies ahead.

spreads.name: Relationship Harmony Spread
spreads.description: A 5-card diagnostic examining personal perspectives, interpersonal bonds, hidden blocks, and mutual growth pathways.

positions.name: Querent / Your Perspective
positions.description: Your emotional state, expectations, and energy brought into the connection.

positions.name: Partner / Other's Perspective
positions.description: Their viewpoint, underlying feelings, and current attitude toward the connection.

positions.name: The Dynamic / Connection
positions.description: The core energy and nature of the bond uniting the two parties.

positions.name: Hidden Influences / Obstacle
positions.description: Unspoken tensions, external pressures, or blind spots requiring illumination.

positions.name: Resolution / Path Forward
positions.description: The potential outcome and constructive guidance for mutual elevation.

spreads.name: Career & Ambition Spread
spreads.description: A 5-card strategic layout evaluating current career standing, ambitions, hidden workplace dynamics, and professional milestones.

positions.name: Current Career Standing
positions.description: Where you currently stand in your professional trajectory and workspace.

positions.name: True Aspirations & Calling
positions.description: Your authentic ambition, creative desires, and ultimate career goals.

positions.name: Challenges & Workplace Blocks
positions.description: Obstacles, competition, internal self-doubt, or organizational friction.

positions.name: Actionable Strategy
positions.description: The tactical step, skill to hone, or decision to execute now.

positions.name: Professional Milestone / Outcome
positions.description: The long-term realization and career success awaiting dedication.

spreads.name: The Celtic Cross Spread
spreads.description: The time-honored 10-card master spread dissecting intricate life situations across conscious aims, subconscious drives, past roots, and future convergence.

positions.name: The Present / Heart of the Matter
positions.description: The core situation, query, and central atmosphere enveloping the querent.

positions.name: The Challenge / Crossing Card
positions.description: The immediate obstacle, friction, or catalyst crossing the present energy.

positions.name: The Past / Deep Foundation
positions.description: The underlying roots, past choices, and foundational events giving rise to today.

positions.name: Passing Influences / Recent Past
positions.description: Energies or circumstances that are receding and fading out of relevance.

positions.name: Conscious Goal / The Crown
positions.description: What you consciously aspire toward and the highest attainable ideal in this scenario.

positions.name: Immediate Horizon / Near Future
positions.description: Upcoming events and shifts arriving in the immediate future.

positions.name: The Querent / Internal Mindset
positions.description: Your internal perspective, emotional posture, and how you perceive yourself in this moment.

positions.name: External Influences & Environment
positions.description: The social circle, family, friends, workplace context, and external environment.

positions.name: Hopes & Secret Fears
positions.description: Your deepest psychological hopes and the corresponding subconscious anxieties.

positions.name: Ultimate Outcome / Culmination
positions.description: The synthesized culmination of energies and the ultimate long-term trajectory.

spreads.name: Life Path & Soul Purpose Spread
spreads.description: A 7-card esoteric layout illuminating the querent's spiritual essence, karmic challenges, innate blessings, and highest personal potential.

positions.name: Core Soul Identity
positions.description: Your authentic spiritual frequency and true higher-self essence.

positions.name: Current Incarnate Path
positions.description: The earthly journey and lesson path you are actively traversing.

positions.name: Karmic Lesson
positions.description: The recurring life lesson and spiritual debt to be integrated with grace.

positions.name: Innate Gifts & Blessings
positions.description: Your natural talents, psychic gifts, and intuitive strengths.

positions.name: Subconscious Shadow & Potential
positions.description: Unawakened powers and hidden dimensions waiting to be integrated into consciousness.

positions.name: The Next Spiritual Horizon
positions.description: The gateway and transformative shift opening in your life journey.

positions.name: Ultimate Spiritual Destiny
positions.description: The highest realization of your purpose and personal enlightenment in this lifetime.
